title: Position and Direction
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4; not yet checked by a Kenyan maths teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Outcomes a to d are KICD's words (verified); e attitudinal. Outcomes b and d say 'demonstrate' a turn: they are done with the body in the classroom and are listed on skills a and c as the hands-on side. The turns are quarter, half and full (HOREB's earlier list said 'three-quarter', which is not in the design for this grade).

skills.key_step: The child says clockwise is the way clock hands move (top to the right) and anticlockwise is the opposite.

floor.prerequisite: Turns to the right and to the left from a point (Grade 3).
floor.question: Turn to your right. Which hand points forward now?

steps: Watch a clock hand: it goes over the top to the right.
Look from above: the view from below is reversed.

board.do: Draw a clock with an arrow going from 12 to 3.
Draw the opposite arrow and write anticlockwise.

misconceptions.ask: Which way does the top of a clock hand move?
If you look from below, does the turn look the same?
Try it beside the clock. Which way did the lid go?

checks.question: The hands of a clock turn which way?
Which way is the opposite of clockwise?

skills.key_step: The child knows a quarter turn is one of four equal turns of a full turn, a half turn faces the opposite way, and a full turn comes back to the start.

floor.question: Which way do clock hands turn?

representations: the body turning to face walls of the classroom
a clock: quarter past, half past
steps: A full turn is all the way round.
A half turn faces the opposite way.
A quarter turn is one of four equal turns.
Say the direction: clockwise or anticlockwise.
contexts: a matatu turning at a roundabout
a dance at a school festival

board.do: Draw a compass rose: N, E, S, W.

board.say: Face north and make a quarter turn clockwise. Where do you face?

board.do: Draw the quarter arc from N to E.

misconceptions.ask: How many quarter turns make a full turn?
misconceptions.repair: Four: a quarter is one of them.

misconceptions.ask: Which way does a clock hand go from 12?

misconceptions.repair: Yes, all the way round: facing east again.

misconceptions.ask: Is a half turn one quarter or two?

checks.question: You face east and make a half turn. Which way do you face?
You face south and make a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way do you face?
